back: Body at rest. Zero energy expenditure. All joints neutral. The starting position for all movement.
Upper body pulls while lower body drags. Belly on ground. Arms reach forward and pull back. No leg coordination yet.
Opposite arm/leg move together. Spine parallel to ground. Cross-pattern coordination emerges. The foundation of gait.
Full upright posture. Ankles micro-adjust continuously. Center of mass over midfoot. The hardest checkpoint — balance against gravity.
Reciprocal gait cycle. 60% stance, 40% swing. Heel strike → mid-stance → toe-off. Arms counter-rotate for stability.
First intentional flight. Both feet push simultaneously. Knees and hips triple-extend. Arms swing upward for momentum. Landing absorbs 3-5× bodyweight. The bridge between walk and run.
Both feet leave ground during stride. Arms drive forward/back. 3× energy of walking. Flight phase distinguishes run from walk. Jump taught the body flight — run sustains it.
